name: EPFL Excellence Fellowships (Master's)
funding: CHF 10,000 a semester for up to four semesters (CHF 40,000 in all) for top applicants to an EPFL master's; tuition for most international students is CHF 2,190 a semester.
deadline: Master's application paid and validated by December 15, reference letters a week later (EPFL gives no year; the first window opens in mid-November)
